whyThisMatters: A fire inspection comes back because someone official requires it. The software that books the visit and writes the report becomes the record. ServiceTrade does that for commercial fire protection, HVAC, kitchen exhaust, and mechanical work. Durham, North Carolina. Billy Marshall is the founder. GetLatka estimates about 30.4 million dollars a year as of October 2024, and about 19.6 million in December 2023. A 6.3 million dollar reading for August 2020 has no source. 34.1 million dollars was raised over two rounds, including 30 million in August 2020. 211 employees in December 2024. The yearly figures stay side by side. The homepage blocks automated visits, and the brief still names servicetrade.com as the product.
